subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Describe, compare and order numbers to 99
source.subtopic: Describe and compare numbers to 80 (weeks 1-2) and 99 (weeks 5-6, 9-10): smaller than, greater than, >, <, =

show.line: Which is greater, 47 or 74? Look at the tens. Seven tens beat four tens. 74 is greater!

rounds.praise: Yes! Six tens is more than three tens.
Yes! Fifty eight is smaller than eighty five.

rounds.prompt: The crocodile eats the bigger number. 29 and 92. Which sign fits?
Which is greater, 51 or 49? Say the number.
Both numbers are seventy. Which sign fits?
Greater than fifty or smaller than fifty? Put each number in its group.

hints: Look at the tens first. More tens means a greater number.
Same tens? Then look at the ones.

beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: 38 is greater than 83, because eight is a big number!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Look at the tens. Eight tens beat three tens. 83 is greater.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look at the tens together. Three tens, eight tens. 83 is greater!

parent_line: Can compare two numbers to 99 using greater than, less than and equal.
